public_rationale: The October selloff is relevant evidence of stress. Funding research still describes strong, concentrated AI investment through September. These records do not establish the broad severe collapse required for early resolution. Because Zitron gives no deadline, continued investment cannot establish that the forecast is false.
limitations: The tentative consequences elsewhere in the sentence are not treated as firm promises.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: A horrible AI crash is coming.

statement.excerpt: I believe that we are on course for a truly horrible crash, the likes of which may rewrite the venture capital industry and mortally wound one or more hyperscalers, as well as fundamentally divide society on so many levels into those that fell for this and those that did not.

our_interpretation: The firm commitment is a future severe AI-sector crash. 'I believe' introduces the prediction rather than a conditional antecedent.
In context, the claim concerns the AI investment boom centered on the named US hyperscalers and AI developers.
A crash means a broad, severe collapse in AI valuations accompanied by substantial disruption of financing, investment, or business activity.
No numerical drawdown threshold or deadline is supplied. Do not invent either.
criteria.support_condition: Dated evidence establishes a broad, severe AI-sector collapse after publication, with major damage beyond a brief or isolated stock-price correction.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite period of continued growth alone disproves an eventual crash without a deadline. Contradiction would require a terminal event that makes the forecast impossible under the same interpretation.
